info.title: Gardien API
info.description: API-first contract for the Gardien PWA, future mobile client, and ESP32 layer.

post.description: Single-user today: the first registration becomes the owner. Structured so additional users can be enabled later.

post.summary: Log in and receive a JWT

get.summary: Look up the USDA hardiness zone for a ZIP (cached, degrades gracefully)
Get the account's saved location & hardiness zone

put.summary: Set the account's zone — by ZIP (auto lookup) or manual override
put.description: Provide `hardinessZone` to set a manual override, or `zip` to derive the zone from a lookup. Manual values are never overwritten by a later ZIP change unless you send a new zip without a zone.

delete.summary: Archive (soft-delete) a garden — history is preserved
Archive (soft-delete) a bed — planting history is preserved

get.summary: A bed with its current plantings, planting history, and amendments
Plan-time conflict report for a bed in a season
get.description: Evaluates the bed’s planned/planted plantings for a season and reports incompatible neighbours, rotation violations, overcrowding, and zone suitability.

get.summary: Recommended plants for a bed in a season, from rotation history
get.description: Suggests what to grow next: feeder-succession order (e.g. legumes after heavy feeders), excluding rotation conflicts and zone-unsuitable plants.
Filter by text (`q`), `type`, `familyId`, zone suitability (`zone`), season (`month`, needs `zone`), and `companionOf` (a plant id).

post.summary: Add a plant to the directory

get.summary: Get a plant with windows, pests/diseases, and companions

post.summary: Add or override a planting/harvest window for a zone
Add a pest or disease to a plant
Link a companion or antagonist plant

get.summary: List planting records (filter by bed and/or season)

patch.summary: Update a planting record (e.g. plan → planted → harvested)

get.summary: List soil amendments (filter by bed and/or season)
Export all of the account’s data as JSON
Localized forecast, frost warnings, and pest/disease watch

post.summary: Register a device (returns a one-time token)
Rotate a device’s token (returns the new one-time token)

get.summary: List a device’s sensor readings (newest first)
Irrigation config, the current fail-safe decision, and recent runs

post.summary: Run the fail-safe rules now; logs a run if irrigation is warranted
Ingest a batch of buffered sensor readings (device token auth)
post.description: Authenticated by the per-device token (Bearer <deviceId>.<secret>). Re-sending buffered readings is idempotent via the (device, metric, recordedAt) key.
